reviews.text: We had a truly positive experience with Luca! He cared for our two cats for two weeks with great care, reliability, and availability. He kept us updated, and we left feeling confident knowing they were in good hands. Highly recommended!

Luca, who looked after our Fru, was attentive and excellent with our big cat. During the days he cared for him, he not only documented Fru's health and what she was doing step by step, but he never failed to give him attention and make us feel at ease. We are very satisfied and happy to have met Luca and Angie and to have entrusted our cat to them ☺️

Angie won my hearts almost immediately! Very thorough, helpful, and in love with cats. She always sends videos and photos of visits, which is crucial for anyone who entrusts their cats to her. Highly recommended (and I say this as a super anxious person 😅) …

Angie and Luca were wonderful. They cared for my cat with care and love, even though she's not the easiest cat to meet strangers. They even gave her a birthday present while I was away and kept me updated throughout their visits! I highly recommend them! Thank you so much!

Angie loves animals. I'll start with this simple, yet crucial, statement. Another very important thing is that Angie has pets herself, so she knows their needs well! I never thought our Lilibeth (who is naturally wary) would become so attached. She welcomed her so joyfully from the first meeting, so much so that it almost made me jealous... I wouldn't leave Lilibeth in the hands of any other cat sitter.

Angie and Luca: the best cat sitters in the neighborhood!
Thank you again for your attention, care, and availability.
Great professionalism.
A must-have for all cats in the area.
Thank you!

Angie and Luca were fantastic! It was the first time my cat was home alone for more than two weeks, but thanks to them, he never felt alone. They demonstrated great professionalism, punctuality, and, above all, a lot of passion and love for what they do. Ugo is thrilled to have found new friends who care for him with love and attention.
A huge thank you to you! 🐾

Reliable, calm, and true animal lovers
Your furry friends will be as happy as you are.
The "humiliating" thing is that my idiot cat prefers her to me... 🙂😉. Punctual, precise but above all reliable. …
Thanks Alice! See you next time ❤️
Kind, polite, and absolutely professional! I highly recommend her 😊 …

The best experience with a cat sitter.
Angie is wonderful, caring, precise, reliable, and incredibly sweet with cats.
It was a pleasure meeting her, and I'll definitely call her if needed!
A huge hug from me, Elmerico, and Goffredo, who already love her so much ♥️
Angie is professional, punctual, kind, and honest. She immediately took to the kitten and vice versa. I'm completely satisfied with this choice. Glad I found you ❤️

Angie is more than a cat sitter; she takes care of our friends with love and affection. Our two cats were taken very well. We are very happy to have found Angie and will rely on her whenever we need her.

If you want peace of mind, leave your furry friends with Angie and Luca. I have two older cats who are a bit complicated, but they managed the situation perfectly and even won over my somewhat wild cat. They're precise, punctual, and incredibly affectionate with the furry ones, and they regularly send updates during visits. When I returned, I found the cats relaxed and happy, and the house in perfect condition. Highly recommended!

I left my little furry boy with Angie for 10 days, and what can I say? She was simply perfect and punctual in everything. She took care of him just as I do. If you want to go on a vacation without feeling guilty about leaving your furry friend behind, rest assured that he'll be with her on vacation too!

I've finally found a friend for my cat Lily. After a terrible previous experience with a woman posing as a "cat sitter," I can now leave with peace of mind, knowing I'm leaving Lily in good hands. Reliable and meticulous. My little tiger isn't easy going... quite the opposite! Yet Angie isn't intimidated, but tries to approach the beast with a friendly approach. Thanks, Angie <3

Angie is fantastic. I have two cats, a female and a male. Right now, I need a trustworthy person who can patiently and attentively care for my older cat, Leo, who's having trouble eating. With Angie, I feel at ease; I've found a professional, reliable person. My Leo is in good hands.

We always trust Angie to care for our cats when we go on vacation because she's reliable, kind, and always available! She's very attentive and caring and always updates us with photos and videos to let us know how the cats are doing day by day. Highly recommended!
Angie is a sweet, kind, and reliable person. Now that I've found her, I'll always entrust my little Yoko to her care whenever I need her.
